blocks.text: New location addition for the song cycle. Era Zero; its exact Garden World and later fate are unspecified.

The Listening Alcove is a modest rest room beside a quiet garden path. Its exit stays easy to recognize, and visitors can request changes in light, seating and sound. It is not a restoration chamber, an archive of persons, or a hidden part of the House of Returning.
Keshet attends the room. Sova helps arrange quiet intervals in the neighboring garden. Room to Restore begins here when a visitor asks for a steady sound during rest.
The Garden Worlds are an established tradition. This particular alcove and its occupants are newly authored supporting lore, with no claim that the room survives into Era Three.
